reviews.title: GREAT FOR TRACKING POTTY USE!
reviews.contents:
I don’t know how this app doesn’t have as many reviews as it should. I think it’s great! 

Easy to track. Very straight forward! 

You have the option to pay for a premium but without it it still does the trick! We are 5 days into potty training and I wish I had this on day one! It’s a good visual to see how well my little one is progressing!

reviews.title: A real joke
reviews.contents: After FIRST HOUR using it, it already ask you to pay for a plan. It doesn’t allow you to play the timer and other basics settings, without joining a monthly plan!! I don’t even know if the app will help me, how do you guys expect that a customer pay for a plan without being able to test the basics of your app?

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.contents: I purchased the app and was sad to realise that my previous purchase was not valid when I upgraded my iPhone 10 to iPhone 12. I sent an email to support to get assistance with this and no one had the decency to reply and help me sort this out.
